import pytest
from mcp.server.mcpserver.exceptions import ToolError
from mcp.server.mcpserver.limits import LimitPolicy
from mcp.server.mcpserver.tools.base import Tool
from mcp.server.mcpserver.tools.tool_manager import ToolManager


def sample_tool(value: int) -> int:
    """Sample tool function for testing."""
    return value * 2


def test_tool_model_limits_field_default():
    assert Tool.model_fields["limits"].default is None


def test_tool_from_function_default_limits_none():
    tool = Tool.from_function(sample_tool)
    assert tool.limits is None


def test_tool_from_function_with_policy():
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    tool = Tool.from_function(sample_tool, limits=policy)
    assert tool.limits is policy


def test_tool_from_function_explicit_none_limits():
    tool = Tool.from_function(sample_tool, limits=None)
    assert tool.limits is None


def test_tool_from_function_limits_is_keyword_only():
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        Tool.from_function(sample_tool, "sample", None, None, None, None, None, None, None, policy)


def test_tool_manager_add_tool_default_limits_none():
    manager = ToolManager()
    tool = manager.add_tool(sample_tool)
    assert tool.limits is None


def test_tool_manager_add_tool_with_policy():
    manager = ToolManager()
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    tool = manager.add_tool(sample_tool, limits=policy)
    assert tool.limits is policy


def test_tool_manager_add_tool_explicit_none_limits():
    manager = ToolManager()
    tool = manager.add_tool(sample_tool, limits=None)
    assert tool.limits is None


def test_tool_manager_add_tool_limits_is_keyword_only():
    manager = ToolManager()
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        manager.add_tool(sample_tool, "sample", None, None, None, None, None, None, policy)


def test_tool_manager_add_tool_duplicate_ignores_new_limits():
    manager = ToolManager(warn_on_duplicate_tools=False)
    p1 = LimitPolicy()
    p2 = LimitPolicy()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=p1)
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=p2)
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is p1


def test_tool_manager_add_tool_duplicate_with_none_preserves_policy():
    manager = ToolManager(warn_on_duplicate_tools=False)
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=policy)
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=None)
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is policy


def test_tool_manager_add_tool_duplicate_returns_existing_tool():
    manager = ToolManager(warn_on_duplicate_tools=False)
    p1 = LimitPolicy()
    p2 = LimitPolicy()
    first = manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=p1)
    second = manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=p2)
    assert second is first


def test_tool_manager_init_tools_preserves_policy():
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    tool = Tool.from_function(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=policy)
    manager = ToolManager(tools=[tool])
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is policy


def test_tool_manager_init_tools_preserves_none_limits():
    tool = Tool.from_function(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=None)
    manager = ToolManager(tools=[tool])
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is None


def test_tool_manager_get_limits_returns_policy():
    manager = ToolManager()
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=policy)
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is policy


def test_tool_manager_get_limits_returns_none_when_unlimited():
    manager = ToolManager()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=None)
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is None


def test_tool_manager_get_limits_unknown_tool_returns_none():
    manager = ToolManager()
    assert manager.get_limits("unknown_tool") is None


def test_tool_manager_get_limits_empty_string_returns_none():
    manager = ToolManager()
    assert manager.get_limits("") is None


def test_tool_manager_set_limits_replaces_policy():
    manager = ToolManager()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a")
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    manager.set_limits("tool_a", policy)
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is policy


def test_tool_manager_set_limits_replaces_previous_policy():
    manager = ToolManager()
    p1 = LimitPolicy()
    p2 = LimitPolicy()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=p1)
    manager.set_limits("tool_a", p2)
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is p2


def test_tool_manager_set_limits_updates_get_tool_limits():
    manager = ToolManager()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a")
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    manager.set_limits("tool_a", policy)
    assert manager.get_tool("tool_a").limits is policy


def test_tool_manager_set_limits_none_clears_policy():
    manager = ToolManager()
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=policy)
    manager.set_limits("tool_a", None)
    assert manager.get_limits("tool_a") is None


def test_tool_manager_set_limits_none_updates_get_tool_limits():
    manager = ToolManager()
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    manager.add_tool(sample_tool, name="tool_a", limits=policy)
    manager.set_limits("tool_a", None)
    assert manager.get_tool("tool_a").limits is None


def test_tool_manager_set_limits_unknown_tool_raises_tool_error():
    manager = ToolManager()
    policy = LimitPolicy()
    with pytest.raises(ToolError, match=r"^Unknown tool: nonexistent$"):
        manager.set_limits("nonexistent", policy)


def test_tool_manager_set_limits_unknown_tool_none_raises_tool_error():
    manager = ToolManager()
    with pytest.raises(ToolError, match=r"^Unknown tool: nonexistent$"):
        manager.set_limits("nonexistent", None)
